notes: MISMATCH flagged: 'Advanced Materials' does not fit. Twist Bioscience manufactures synthetic DNA (silicon-based synthesis platform) for gene synthesis, NGS library prep, and biopharma antibody/protein discovery (incl. supplying data to Eli Lilly's TuneLab AI drug-discovery initiative). Of the existing theme list, 'Biotech Catalyst' is the closest but implies single binary FDA-style catalysts, which doesn't match Twist's recurring-revenue platform-and-volume-growth story. Proposing a new theme: 'Synthetic Biology & Life Science Tools'. Could not independently re-verify the 2026-09-16 Eli Lilly TuneLab item this session (WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted before a targeted query could run); treat that single catalyst as carried over from the prior unverified snapshot pending confirmation. SEC EDGAR and most IR/press sites were unreachable via WebFetch in this sandbox; figures are WebSearch-tool-summarized from secondary sources (GenomeWeb, RTT News, Nasdaq.com articles, MarketBeat, Earnings Whispers, equibles.com) rather than primary 10-Q/8-K text.
